cc:Work.dc:title: OOD steering improvement
cc:Work.dc:description: Source-selected directions are applied to eng-french without refitting. † clean lexically disjoint semantic-domain OOD; ‡ overlapping-vocabulary pair-mixture diagnostic. LLMs are not pooled.
